summary: Frontend-only E2E test of new draft-deletion UI in Load Quote modal (individual × delete + 'Delete all'). Created 3 drafts via toolbar tab-add-btn, opened Load modal, verified all flows. All 6 review-request scenarios pass with 0 console errors.

test_results.setup_create_drafts: PASS — clicked tab-add-btn twice; 3 draft tabs/rows present (incl. auto-created).
test_results.delete_all_visible_on_drafts: PASS — load-delete-all-drafts present on Drafts tab.
test_results.individual_delete_cancel: PASS — window.confirm dismissed; row count unchanged (3→3); modal stayed open; draft NOT opened.
test_results.individual_delete_accept: PASS — confirm accepted; row removed (3→2); 'Draft deleted' toast shown; modal stayed open (× did stopPropagation, did NOT open draft).
test_results.delete_all_accept: PASS — confirm message 'Delete ALL 2 draft(s)? This cannot be undone.' shown with correct count; after accept → 0 rows; 'No drafts found' empty state visible; 'All drafts deleted' toast shown; load-delete-all-drafts button hidden when empty.
test_results.tab_bar_reset_after_delete_all: PASS — tab bar collapsed to single blank New Quote tab with fresh est# SA-260616-200152.
test_results.saved_tab_still_works: PASS — Saved Quotes tab still loads (6 saved rows visible) after delete-all.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: onMouseEnter handler on × button calls e.stopPropagation() inside a hover handler, which has no functional effect (hover doesn't bubble like click). Harmless but dead code; can be removed. The real stopPropagation in onDeleteDraft handler works correctly.
Confirm-dialog UX uses native window.confirm — consistent with rest of app per the brief, but a styled Modal (like TakeOverConfirm in same file) would be more on-brand. Not a blocker.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 transient drafts during test; all were deleted by the delete-all flow as part of the test. State is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Draft deletion feature is fully working. data-testids verified: toolbar-load, load-tab-drafts, load-tab-saved, load-row-<id>, load-draft-delete-<id>, load-delete-all-drafts, tab-add-btn. window.confirm dialogs handled via page.once('dialog', ...) — accept or dismiss as needed.
